reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Firming Gel Mask Sheet 4ea
reviews.text: Super moisturising mask! And I love the gel material over traditional masks since it’s less irritating for the skin. Fits very well too and stays on!
reviews.zh: 超保濕嘅 mask！而且比起傳統 mask 我更鍾意 gel 質地，冇咁刺激皮膚。貼面度一流，又貼得實！

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Firming Gel Mask Sheet 4ea
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed using these gel mask sheets! The texture feels cooling and refreshing on the skin, and the mask fits nicely without slipping. It’s packed with essence, so my skin feels deeply hydrated after each use.

After leaving it on for about 15–20 minutes, my skin looks plumper, smoother, and more radiant. It gives a nice firming effect and makes my complexion look healthier and more refreshed.

There’s no sticky residue afterward — just soft, moisturized skin. Perfect for a self-care night or before an event when you want your skin to look its best. I’ll definitely repurchase!
reviews.zh:
我真係好鍾意用呢啲gel mask sheets！質地敷上面涼爽又refreshing，塊mask貼服唔會滑走。精華液好足，所以每次用完之後皮膚都feel到深層保濕。

敷咗大概15–20分鐘之後，塊面望落更加飽滿、更滑、更有光澤。有好好嘅緊緻效果，令膚色望落去更健康、更有精神。

用完之後冇黐立立嘅殘留——只有柔軟、保濕嘅皮膚。最啱夜晚自我護膚，又或者想喺出席活動之前皮膚狀態去到最好嘅時候用。一定會回購！

reviews.text: This gel mask is a great for its value! Leaves skins hydrated, firm, and plump after use. I staple after care mask!

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Firming Gel Mask Sheet 4ea
reviews.text: I was a bit disappointed not to find a neck mask inside, but it did firm my face. I’d only consider repurchasing if a neck mask is included.
reviews.zh: 入面冇搵到neck mask，有少少失望，但塊面真係firm咗。要有neck mask先會考慮回購。

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Firming Gel Mask Sheet 4ea
reviews.text:
I'm a huge Torriden fan, for real! I love most of their products, and these masks are no exception! It's super easy to put on the face, it doesn't fall off, and I can wear it while working from home, sitting at my desk.
I put it on a couple of hours before getting my makeup ready, and for real, I had THE BEST makeup of my life that day. My skin was flawless and super hydrated, so my base and everything else just perfectly stayed on my face like it never had before. Purchasing and repurchasing for the foreseeable!!!
reviews.zh:
我係Torriden嘅超級粉絲，真心嘅！我鍾意佢哋大部分產品，呢啲mask都唔例外！超級容易貼上面，唔會跌落嚟，喺屋企work from home坐喺書枱前都戴得到。
我化妝前幾個鐘就敷上，講真，嗰日嘅妝係我人生中最好嘅一次。皮膚完美又超級保濕，所以底妝同其他嘢完美貼住塊面，從未試過咁貼。已購買，亦會持續回購！！！

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Firming Gel Mask Sheet 4ea
reviews.text: These are awesome for when you dont have the patience to do a 3 hour or the time to do a three hour biodance mask. obviously its not as dazzling as the biodance but it does a great job for those special occasions where you want glowy skin! Not nice enough to make me want to repurchase though...
reviews.zh: 呢啲mask好適合冇耐性又或者冇時間做3個鐘biodance mask嘅時候用。顯然冇biodance咁搶眼，但喺想皮膚有glowy感覺嘅特別場合就做得好好！但未夠好到我會想回購……
